verdict.rationale: Square docs confirm receipts can be customized per location with custom text fields for disclaimers/promotions (square-docs-27), and Terminal API/checkout flows reference receipt-related fields (tips, signatures) implying receipt issuance is built-in. However, there is no explicit documentation confirming digital (email/SMS) receipt delivery mechanics or explicit statements about card-network compliance requirements for receipts. missing for 10: explicit docs on email/SMS receipt delivery API, explicit card-network (Visa/Mastercard) compliance details, independent verification of receipt formatting compliance.
